title: Native target principal preflight statement
description: Exact eight-field compact sorted UTF-8 JSON original, no LF, at most 4096 bytes. Shape is not authentication. Only a paired principal-v3 role-3 quote bound to the actual TLS session, actual sent request and independent principal/policy expectations authenticates this statement. It grants no CONNECT, route, provider, egress, canary or enrollment authority.

principalId.description: Actual first matching runtime principal; runtime additionally enforces at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes and trim-stable text. The receiver compares its independent expected principal.

sourceAddress.description: Canonical actual TCP peer IP, or null for vsock. The runtime rejects CIDR-constrained principals when no actual IP exists; forwarded headers and vsock CIDs cannot substitute.

requestBindingSha256.description: HMAC-SHA256 under the separate, non-exported actual TLS request exporter, over the fixed domain, u64-BE original length and exact canonical request. No header/token values or raw guessable header hashes are published.
